name: Support daily work
gloss: Put tooling, data modeling, and research in direct service of our substantive day job.

name: Settle our labeling system
gloss: Establish a consistent doctrine for file state, data properties, and domain entities across differing file kinds and contexts, resolving where metadata lives so material is legible to humans and tools.

name: Establish documentation standards
gloss: Keep our writing compact and high-density, favoring data before display and eliminating narrative bloat.

name: Identify process structures
gloss: Make workflows mechanical, reproducible, and visible through clear stages and automated checks.

name: Clarify terminology
gloss: Stop competing terms from multiplying; retire vague words so each concept has one unambiguous name.
